testSuite: NexusPlay Sprint 01 Identity & Security Advanced Verification (Hardened)
securityControlsVerified: Origin and Referer Validation on Mutating Requests
SHA-256 Hashed Session Secrets at Rest (auth_sessions.token)
SHA-256 Hashed Password Reset Tokens at Rest (password_resets.token)
Cascade Session Revocation Across Devices on Reset
Genuine Password Reset Email Dispatch to Outbox
X-Internal-Test-Key Restricted Outbox Inspection in Staging/Dev
Rotated Dynamic Internal QA Key (Zero Hardcoded Secrets)
Spoofed X-Forwarded-Proto Rejection from Untrusted IP
Spoofed X-Forwarded-For Rejection from Untrusted IP
Unconditional Production HTTPS Secure Cookie Enforcement
Zero Outbox Log & Token Public Exposure
SQLite-Backed Rate Limiting Surviving Process Restarts

tests.name: Successful registration issues user profile, session token, and HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie
tests.expected: HTTP 201 with session token and HttpOnly cookie

tests.name: Duplicate email registration is rejected with HTTP 409 Conflict
tests.actual: HTTP 409 (An account with this email address already exists)

tests.name: Invalid email format rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request
Password shorter than 8 chars rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request
tests.actual: HTTP 400 (Password must be between 8 and 64 characters in length (inclusive))

tests.name: Password without numbers rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request
tests.actual: HTTP 400 (Password must contain at least one number)

tests.name: Display name under 2 chars rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request
tests.expected: HTTP 400 with display name constraint error
tests.actual: HTTP 400 (Display name must be between 2 and 32 characters in length (inclusive))

tests.name: Valid credentials return HTTP 200 with HttpOnly session cookie & CSRF token
Incorrect password returns HTTP 401 with generic error message
Non-existent email returns identical HTTP 401 (prevents user enumeration)
Session validates via ambient HttpOnly Cookie without Authorization header
CSRF Protection: Mutating cookie request without X-CSRF-Token rejected with HTTP 403
tests.actual: HTTP 403 (CSRF token validation failed. Missing or invalid X-CSRF-Token header.)

tests.name: Logout invalidates session and clears HttpOnly session cookies
Revoked session cookie rejected on subsequent requests with HTTP 401
tests.actual: HTTP 401 (Invalid, revoked, or expired session token.)

tests.name: Forgot password generates 15m reset token and dispatches genuine email to outbox
tests.expected: HTTP 200 and email dispatched with resetToken

tests.name: Password reset token is cryptographically hashed at rest (SHA-256) in persistence
tests.expected: DB token matches SHA-256 hash of raw reset token

tests.name: Forgot password for unknown email returns identical HTTP 200 with zero outbound email
Reset password with valid token updates credentials with HTTP 200
tests.actual: HTTP 200 (Password has been reset successfully. Please log in with your new credentials.)

tests.name: Re-using already spent reset token rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request
tests.actual: HTTP 400 (Password reset token is invalid or has already been used)

tests.name: Password reset immediately revokes all prior active sessions across devices
tests.expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized for prior active session
tests.actual: HTTP 401 (Invalid, revoked, or expired session token.)

tests.name: Successfully login with updated password following reset
Expired reset token (>15m) rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request
tests.actual: HTTP 400 (Password reset token has expired. Please request a new reset link.)

tests.name: 5 consecutive failed login attempts trigger HTTP 429 lockout with Retry-After header
tests.expected: HTTP 429 on 5th failure with Retry-After header

tests.name: Rate limit lockout persists across application restarts via persistent database storage
tests.expected: Lockout remains active after in-memory state wipe (HTTP 429)

tests.name: Rate limit lockout isolates by IP+email composite key without blocking other users
Successful login clears failed attempt counter, preventing premature lockout
tests.expected: HTTP 200 resets counter; subsequent failure shows remainingAttempts=4

tests.name: Distributed Brute-Force Defense: Enforces target email protection against rotating IPs
tests.expected: HTTP 429 on 10th distributed attempt across rotating IPs
tests.actual: 10th attempt from new IP -> HTTP 429 (Too many failed authentication attempts. Account access is temporarily locked.)

tests.name: Accessing protected /api/v1/auth/me without token returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized
tests.actual: HTTP 401 (Authentication required. No session token or cookie provided.)

tests.name: Accessing protected endpoint with invalid token returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized
tests.actual: HTTP 401 (Invalid, revoked, or expired session token.)

tests.name: Access to /api/v1/auth/test/outbox without test key header returns HTTP 403 Forbidden
tests.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden with key requirement message
tests.actual: HTTP 403 (Access denied: Valid X-Internal-Test-Key header required for outbox inspection)

tests.name: Retired / previously exposed static QA key rejected with HTTP 403 (verifies rotation)
tests.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden for retired legacy key
tests.actual: HTTP 403 (Access denied: Valid X-Internal-Test-Key header required for outbox inspection)

tests.name: Access with authorized rotated test key returns HTTP 200 and outbox array
Unconfigured environment rejects outbox access with HTTP 403 (no hardcoded fallback)
tests.expected: HTTP 403 "Internal QA outbox access is not configured in this environment"
tests.actual: HTTP 403 (Access denied: Internal QA outbox access is not configured in this environment)

tests.name: Production environment permanently disables outbox access (HTTP 404 Not Found)
tests.expected: HTTP 404 Not Found (outbox disabled in production)
tests.actual: HTTP 404 (Outbox inspection endpoint is permanently disabled in production environments)

tests.name: Direct static requests for email outbox log files return HTTP 404 (no file leakage)
tests.expected: HTTP 404 Not Found for static log file URLs

tests.name: State-changing cookie request missing X-CSRF-Token header rejected with HTTP 403
tests.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden with missing token error
tests.actual: HTTP 403 (CSRF token validation failed. Missing or invalid X-CSRF-Token header.)

tests.name: State-changing cookie request with mismatched X-CSRF-Token header rejected with HTTP 403
tests.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden with mismatched token error
tests.actual: HTTP 403 (CSRF token validation failed. Missing or invalid X-CSRF-Token header.)

tests.name: Cross-session CSRF token attack rejected: Token is not cryptographically bound to session
tests.actual: HTTP 403 (Cross-session CSRF token rejected. Token is not bound to this authenticated session.)

tests.name: Untrusted Origin header rejected on state-changing authenticated cookie request
tests.actual: HTTP 403 (Untrusted Cross-Origin Request. Origin or Referer header rejected.)

tests.name: Untrusted Referer header rejected on state-changing authenticated cookie request
tests.actual: HTTP 403 (Untrusted Cross-Origin Request. Origin or Referer header rejected.)

tests.name: Valid session-bound CSRF token with valid Origin allows state-changing logout
tests.actual: HTTP 200 (Successfully logged out and session revoked)

tests.name: Session secret is cryptographically hashed with SHA-256 at rest in auth_sessions table
tests.expected: DB token equals SHA-256(rawToken) and does not store raw token plaintext

tests.name: Database dump defense: Stored database token hash cannot directly authenticate
tests.expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized for both Bearer and Cookie submissions of stored DB hash

tests.name: Local environment cookie attributes enforce HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax without Secure lock
tests.expected: HttpOnly=true, SameSite=Lax, Secure=false for local HTTP dev

tests.name: HTTPS environment cookie attributes enforce Secure flag on all authentication cookies
tests.expected: Secure=true on both nexusplay_session and nexusplay_csrf in HTTPS

tests.name: Concurrent multi-device sessions supported; password reset revokes all devices in cascade
Reverse Proxy Security: Untrusted client spoofed X-Forwarded-Proto: https ignored
tests.expected: Secure flag omitted when X-Forwarded-Proto originates from untrusted client IP
tests.actual: secureOmitted=true (spoofed header ignored from untrusted IP)

tests.name: Reverse Proxy Security: Trusted proxy forwarding X-Forwarded-Proto: https sets Secure cookie
tests.expected: Secure flag enforced when X-Forwarded-Proto originates from trusted proxy

tests.name: Production Configuration: Session cookies ALWAYS enforce Secure and HttpOnly attributes
tests.expected: Secure=true and HttpOnly=true unconditionally in production

tests.name: Reverse Proxy Security: Untrusted client spoofed X-Forwarded-For ignored for IP tracking
tests.expected: Rate limit tracked against physical socket IP, spoofed X-Forwarded-For discarded
